status: completed exploratory analysis; no new simulations
limitations: Windows and thresholds selected after seeing early deviation; descriptive exploration, not independent confirmation.
Blocks and frames are correlated, no frame-level tests or confidence intervals.
Tail autocorrelation uses only3ns; no stationary distribution, ESS or convergence inferred.
Thresholds are geometric cutoffs, not states or folding probabilities; sampled episodes miss events shorter than10ps.
Extending all three can test persistence but cannot undo common starting conformation or prove rare-event sampling.
